**Install:** download the APK below, allow installs from unknown sources, then follow [Getting started](https://github.com/Edison-Watch/mobile#getting-started).

This is a **debug build**, signed with a CI debug key. It includes **computer control** (an accessibility service that can see and operate other apps), which the Play build leaves out. Computer control is off by default: it only runs after you turn it on in the app *and* enable it in Android's Accessibility settings. Turn it off from the app or the notification at any time.
